fact: On 29 October 2025 the Vice-Prime Minister for the Civil Service and the head of Equity BCDC discussed digitising civil servants' pay and linking the public-agent reference file (FRAP) to the bank's system.
title: Digitalisation de la Fonction Publique : Equity BCDC s'engage aux côtés du VPM Jean-Pierre Lihau
publisher: Portail de la Fonction Publique RDC
